supersedes.reason: v1 strategy killed the launcher pwsh, which left a [process exited with code 1] placeholder tab under WT's default closeOnExit:graceful. Operator caught it via direct visual inspection. v2 corrects by killing only the inner CLI subtree and refactoring the launcher script to exit with code 0 after WaitForExit returns.

note: Single-job, three-story serial decomposition. US-01 surface grew vs v1 because it now ALSO refactors the launcher script (drop -NoExit, capture inner.pid via Start-Process -PassThru, end with exit 0). The Start-Process REPL UX verification is the single largest impl risk; if it fails, fall back to research-brief Option 5B (Node-side WMI polling, keep `& copilot` inline).

The Start-Process REPL UX risk is described in plan Q3 + research-brief §5 Option 5A; impl MUST run the manual interactive sanity check before shipping.
